DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Uterine Atony with secondary Bowel Ileus.

Based on the history of a prolonged labor, a macrosomic (11 lb) infant, decreased bowel sounds, and uterine tenderness, the clinical picture strongly suggests severe uterine atony causing systemic infection/fever and mechanical compression of the intestines leading to an ileus.
